scope: Shared foundation review and precise annotated pilots; not a runtime asset manifest or game patch

coordinate_contract.zero_travel: No gait lookup; base row, reported travel index falls back to aim index. Do not make footsteps from aim changes.
coordinate_contract.zero_aim_in_this_presenter: Static classify_index defaults to SOUTH. Upstream retained-aim behavior cannot be inferred from this function.
coordinate_contract.direction_boundary: abs(x)*1000000 <= abs(y)*414214 chooses N/S; corresponding horizontal comparison chooses E/W. Equality is cardinal.
coordinate_contract.hysteresis: Stateful resolver offers an 8-degree margin (hold dot 0.8616291604415258); frame() calls static classify_index, not resolve_index. No new aim lag proposed.

evidence_legend.SOURCE_VISIBLE: Directly present in read source or inspected source pixels
evidence_legend.DOCUMENTED_NOT_TRACEABLE: Described in supplied docs; required implementation or caller absent
evidence_legend.INFERRED: Review hypothesis, not direct or runtime proof
evidence_legend.MISSING: No corresponding input or slot supplied

clock_contract.driver: realized ground distance, excluding prediction correction and non-gait actions
clock_contract.scalar_note: Small reference/display are both 58. For Middle/Large inspect missing caller before choosing reference or display height. This package does not silently reinterpret it.
clock_contract.stop_and_block: Freeze phase; no catch-up burst. Preserve phase through heading and walk/sprint bank changes.
clock_contract.air_slide_roll: No gait advancement attributed to these modes. Reconcile actual caller before implementation.
clock_contract.offline_timing_note: 800 ms is a viewing aid only. It is not measured or proposed gameplay cadence.

pose_invariants.rig: Use the existing fixed-bone authoring rig when supplied; no new per-character animation system.
pose_invariants.joint_lengths: Retain source rig rest lengths, head/neck dimensions and rigid torso volume. Those values are NOT recoverable exactly from these PNGs.
pose_invariants.head_chest_pelvis_yaw: Same current aim heading; no axial waist twist. Travel changes contact trajectories and lean, not shot aim.
pose_invariants.scale: Never resize each pose to fill the cell or double-apply the baked scale. Pose bounds may change.
pose_invariants.debug_identity: L diamond and R square, labels as well as color; these glyphs are never body art.
pose_invariants.occlusion: Anatomical identity is stable, but draw order follows depth after projection. Do not relabel feet on a turn.
pose_invariants.foot_contact_vs_lowest_pixel: Use rig sole landmarks plus actual receiving surface; sprite alpha bounds are not collision or contact authority.
pose_invariants.body_action_priority: Authoritative death/forced control, airborne/slide/roll/wall locomotion state, then ground gait; legal cast arms may coexist. Inspect actual caller priority before patching.
pose_invariants.interruption: New authoritative locomotion/action state wins immediately. No landing, slide-exit or cast-recovery pose may hold movement or prolong protection.

gait_candidate.scope: Contact readability changes within existing 8-phase banks; not a speed/stride/cap change
gait_candidate.support: P0..P3 left; P4..P7 right. Phase boundaries exchange support without swapping anatomical IDs. Retain accepted source contact ordering if the missing rig proves a different zero phase.
gait_candidate.sole_shape: A planted sole has a stable flat contact cluster; swing toe is separated visibly at native resolution. Avoid both feet looking planted or both looking airborne throughout a walk.
gait_candidate.residual_scope: Proposed sampled-keyframe rig target only, never a measurement of current source PNGs or a guarantee during held frames.
gait_candidate.quantization_limit: With an 8-frame held sprite, translating the actor moves every sprite pixel between frame changes. Exact continuous world-locked feet are impossible without extra presentation machinery. Do not hide this by shifting the authoritative actor or its fixed pivot.
gait_candidate.cadence_limit_risk: At a speed above cycle_distance * cadence_cap, a fixed authored stride necessarily slips. Measure actual speed/caller behavior; do not silently raise cadence or shorten travel to obtain a passing test.

pilots.title: Forward walk · alternating support
pilots.source_label: SOURCE LOOKUP · walk T0 / A0 · exact phases 0–7
pilots.observed: Eight distinct poses already exchange the apparent advancing leg. A still strip cannot establish world-space planting.
pilots.proposal: Keep the eight-phase distance clock. Make the supporting sole flat, the passing toe visibly lifted, and the two anatomical feet distinguishable without debug color.
pilots.native_review: Observe at 1x before enlarging. Do not call a moving foot planted just because it is the lowest pixel.
pilots.runtime_gate: Measure realized ground displacement and sole samples over two cycles; repeat blocked, stopping, turning and walk-to-sprint.

pilots.title: True diagonal slide · travel NE / aim S
pilots.source_label: SOURCE LOOKUP · slide T3 / A0 · phase ignored by this presenter
pilots.observed: The source has a real NE slide drawing, but selection uses aim, not travel. This probe therefore repeats the S slide cell, even while travel is NE.
pilots.proposal: Author contact and recline along actual NE travel with head/chest/pelvis yaw still S. Slide soles glide; they must not be labeled alternating walk plants.
pilots.native_review: Look for a recognizable travel axis without relying on arrows, a skid particle trail or a rotated South bitmap.
pilots.runtime_gate: Actual diagonal admission, momentum, brake, exit, wall contact and all 64 travel/aim pairs need the missing caller and live captures.

pilots.title: Backpedal · travel N / aim S
pilots.source_label: SOURCE LOOKUP · walk T4 / A0 · distinct from forward bank
pilots.observed: A separate backward travel/forward aim sequence already exists. It is not an absent feature or merely the forward strip played backward.
pilots.proposal: Keep face and ready hands on S. Use a clear rearward placement, low passing toe and alternating support; no 180-degree waist twist.
pilots.native_review: The viewer should identify travel as N with the direction arrows hidden, while identifying aim as S.
pilots.runtime_gate: Repeat with rapid aim reversal, actual deceleration through zero, collision and the back-diagonal neighbors.

pilots.title: Strafe while casting · travel N / aim E
pilots.source_label: GAIT-ONLY PROBE · T4 / A2 · not a replay of live cast routing
pilots.observed: The checkpoint says moving casts retain gait legs without a new arm layer. Direct frame("cast", ...) instead selects a static base cell. The caller resolving these choices is absent.
pilots.proposal: Preserve gait phase while an admitted hand action reads startup, release and recovery. Current body aim turns immediately; a committed shot keeps its recorded start aim.
pilots.native_review: The arm extension must be readable at 1x without glow. Release a hand pose on the release event, not merely when a locomotion phase number is reached.
pilots.runtime_gate: Admitted/refused cast, release while turning, repeated Rapid casts, all four families, interruption and frame-rate changes; no restart of feet.
pilots.asterisk: The eight displayed labels are a storyboard sample, not an action-to-gait phase coupling or measured cast timing.

pilots.title: Airborne → contact → recovery
pilots.source_label: STORYBOARD · jump ×2, grounded ×6 · no landing body exists in this manifest
pilots.observed: There is a jump cell and a grounded cell, but no land/compression row. Their source soles both register at the feet pivot; physical lift is separate.
pilots.proposal: On confirmed landing, plant both feet, bend fixed-length knees and lower the rigid torso; recover without adding a control lock. Do not recycle a one-foot walk pose as landing.
pilots.native_review: Distinguish airborne feet from ground contact at normal and reduced effects. Keep the receiving-surface shadow separate from the body.
pilots.runtime_gate: Jump/Float/air-dodge/wall exit/fast fall into landing; immediate re-jump, moving cast, platform or height changes, prediction correction and death.
pilots.asterisk: Precontact is an offline illustration only. Never predict a ground plant from a sprite, shadow or expected touchdown time.

slide.selection: travel × aim; existing 8-direction order; eight action pose slots, not a looping walk clock
slide.hold_duration: Driven by actual admitted slide; never fixed by this spec
slide.hold_animation: Prefer one stable held body; optional second hold pose must not simulate new steps.
slide.timing_boundaries: Presentation-only proposals. No new admission, sustain, protection, brake, cost or cooldown intervals. Clip cosmetic entry/exit immediately if authority changes.
slide.geometry: Gliding long/tucked soles and recline follow travel. Head/chest/pelvis yaw still aim. A diagonal is authored in 3D rig/projected, never a 2D-rotated cardinal sprite.
slide.contact: SLIDING contact, not a planted walk sole. Wallrun cannot inherit a new deeper slide recline without its own contact regression.

moving_cast.input_fields: Conceptual channels only; actual runtime field names and caller are missing.
moving_cast.null_reason: Family-specific live timing must come from missing cast presentation state, not an invented universal duration.
moving_cast.release_alignment: On the actual release event; do not delay for a gait contact or move the committed projectile.
moving_cast.gait_blend: Lower gait phase continues. Upper body follows current aim. Do not cross-fade the whole actor or reset foot phase.
moving_cast.draw_implementation: Start with offline existing-rig composites. A bounded masked hand/forearm overlay could avoid combinatorial full-body pages, but it is an unapproved renderer/schema extension, not a supplied live layer.
moving_cast.spell_layer: No glow, projectiles, elemental particles or magic aura baked into body.

landing.trigger: Confirmed airborne→ground contact / lifecycle event, not guessed sprite height or elapsed jump time
landing.negative_offset_note: Illustrative descent samples, not predictive runtime precontact logic.
landing.compression_method: Bend fixed-length knees; move rigid head/torso together. No vertical raster scale or squash. Feet remain on the confirmed receiving surface.
landing.contact_pose: Dedicated two-foot load pose; the historical walk-frame shortcut was rejected.
landing.moving_landing: Retain travel and gait context; interrupted recovery must not drag both planted soles with a translating root. Lift a foot into the first legal moving support immediately.
landing.intensity: Canonical 0..1000 landing intensity is documented; use it only to scale bounded cosmetic compression. Exact field name/sampler unavailable.
landing.normal_reduced: Identical contact event, limb pose and interruption. Keep optional secondary cues reduced; preserve separately owned documented 28/7px airborne lift behavior rather than rebaking it.
landing.zero_lift: A reduced-effects small lift must not be mistaken for grounded contact.

order: all sizes and actions human acceptance
transfer.method: Transfer normalized pose rules/contact labels/timing, not scaled copies of the Small bitmap. Bake Middle at 63/68 and Large at 68/76 exactly once about (48,84).
transfer.large_warning: Broader projected shoulders/hands and 19px hurt radius do not authorize different wall clearance or longer visual protection.
transfer.native_tolerances: One-pixel cluster/gutter review after each per-size bake; rigid source bones preserved before rasterization.

integration_budget.budget_note: CPU/GPU upload, texture padding, simultaneous banks and draw costs not measured. Overlay geometry/occlusion remains unapproved. No full action/skin expansion before pilot acceptance.
